title: Optional Vehicle Coverage Attachment Matrix by Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Package
content:
The coverage package of a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy decides which optional coverages may be attached to the vehicles scheduled on it: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage, Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, Cardinal Roadside Assistance and enrollment in a Cardinal DriveSense program. It also decides whether vehicles qualify for new car replacement on a total loss.

## Attachment matrix

| Package | Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage may be attached | Highest Cardinal Rental Reimbursement option rank | Highest Cardinal Roadside Assistance option rank | Cardinal DriveSense enrollment allowed | New car replacement included |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Auto Essential | No | 0 (not available) | 1 | Yes | No |
| Cardinal Auto Basic | Yes | 2 | 2 | Yes | No |
| Cardinal Auto Standard | Yes | 3 | 3 | Yes | No |
| Cardinal Auto Plus | Yes | 4 | 4 | Yes | No |
| Cardinal Auto Preferred | Yes | 6 | 5 | Yes | Yes |
| Cardinal Auto Premier | Yes | 6 | 6 | Yes | Yes |

## Notes to the matrix

- The rental and roadside columns give the highest option rank that may be attached on the package; an option ranked at or below that figure may be attached, an option ranked above it may not. A rental figure of 0 means Cardinal Rental Reimbursement is not available on Cardinal Auto Essential at all.
- New car replacement marks whether vehicles on the package qualify for new car replacement on a total loss. The tests a vehicle must meet to receive it belong to Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage, not to the package.
- Cardinal DriveSense enrollment is allowed on every package.

## Points of judgement

**Can a vehicle on Cardinal Auto Essential carry Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage?** No. Physical damage coverage may not be attached on that package, and its rental figure of 0 means rental reimbursement is unavailable as well.

**A Cardinal Auto Standard policy, roadside option of rank 4 requested (hypothetical).** The package's highest roadside rank is 3, so a rank 4 option may not be attached; an option of rank 3 or lower may.

**Which packages include new car replacement?** Only Cardinal Auto Preferred and Cardinal Auto Premier.
